text:
Lina (recruiter): quick flag 44 offer for Dev (backend) 9 candidate requesting 2026-08-01 start, relocating from LATAM. Manager asking for $4k sign-on + provisional uplift +2.5% to base, and benefits effective day 1. Can we route an exception?
Priya (people-ops): 1-line please: asks + biz reason + docs ETA.
Lina (recruiter): Ask: $4k one-time sign-on; +2.5% uplift (within band but > auto refresher?); benefits on start date. Reason: competitor counteroffer and critical platform owner. Candidate can provide passport + local address by 2026-07-20.
Jon (hiring manager): Confirming impact: losing candidate delays release by ~4 weeks. I approve sign-on from discretionary.
Elaine (comp): +2.5% is under 3% auto threshold? policy says <=3% auto approve, confirm band code. If it's within band and under 3% I can note approval; otherwise need memo. Lina please paste comp snippet.
Lina (recruiter): comp snippet:
```
Base: 135000
Sign-on: 4000 (one-time)
Uplift: +2.5% (~3375 annualized)
Est first-year comp: 142375
```
Hana (finance): Finance: GL code please (likely 5012), and confirm headcount. Sign-on can be charged to hiring discretionary. Day-1 benefits requires run-rate note if uplift approved.
Lina (recruiter): GL=5012, headcount open.
Raj (onboarding): Ops note: benefits enrollment feed needs 72h lead. For LATAM relocation we need ID + address verification before feed; otherwise coverage may start later. Can candidate provide docs by 2026-07-20?
Lina (recruiter): candidate commits to provide by 2026-07-18.
LegalBot: For day-1 benefits we add clause: "Benefits eligibility will commence on the employee's start date, subject to carrier rules and timely verification of required documents." Will add if People Ops signs.
Priya (people-ops): routing plan: Manager -> Comp (Elaine) -> Finance (Hana) -> People Ops final. Legal & Onboarding looped. If Elaine confirms it's auto we can finalize offer today. Target decision 2026-07-15.
Elaine (comp): Confirming: +2.5% is within auto policy (<=3%). I mark comp note: auto-approved. No committee.
Hana (finance): Finance note: confirmed GL 5012 and headcount. Provisionally approve sign-on and no committee for uplift. Record run-rate impact in tracker.
Priya (people-ops): Great 0 next steps: Lina to attach relocation docs when ready; Legal to inject clause; Onboarding to queue benefits feed. If all good People Ops will finalize offer by 2026-07-16.
Lina (recruiter): will upload docs and issue offer today with day-1 clause. Thanks! :thumbsup:
